states.passed: Real evidence: the operation ran through the installed CLI against the authenticated service in a journey cited from a dated live record (a harness step or an issue-901-cli8-live json), with its observable effect and applicable denial, revision and retry cases; synthetic fixtures alone never qualify.
states.bounded: Covered only by deterministic or synthetic fixtures (fixture runtime, scripted or fake GitHub, seeded recovery facts, in-process or packed CLI, loopback or a throwaway-certificate TLS proxy) or by an earlier live observation, or real evidence limited by a recorded defect; the gap states the bound.
states.unproved: No test invokes the operation through the CLI against the authenticated service; the gap states the missing check.

CLI01.basis: Host side real: the host live journey (issue-901-cli8-live-2026-10-12.json, Codex, 2 turns) ran the packed binary installed outside the checkout, with Keychain and token-file logins, investigated the failed task (search, result, execution inputs with the submitted digest, logs, bound instructions), compared current settings and prepared the profile diff. Missing: the second privately connected machine over verified HTTPS; the TLS-proxy and redirect checks are same-host fixtures only. Unproved: prerequisite unavailable (no second trusted machine was granted).

CLI02.basis: Renewed CLI1 Chromium suite (UI creation, metadata listing, one-time reveal, rotation before revocation, revocation readback, verifier-only storage, Origin and CSRF), renewed route-wide scope denial fixtures, and in the host live journey (issue-901-cli8-live-2026-10-12.json, Codex, 2 turns): session-issued credentials, read-only CLI apply exit 3 and direct POST 403 insufficient-scope with the database digest unchanged, revocation during logs --follow exit 3, local logout leaving the server credential active until revoked (200 then 401), bearer 403 on /runtime/control and session-only credential routes. Scope: one host on loopback. Bounded: UI provisioning is qualified by the Chromium suite against a loopback fixture service, not on this live run.

CLI03.basis: In the host live journey (issue-901-cli8-live-2026-10-12.json, Codex, 2 turns): exact profile apply creating revision 2 and an identical replay returning the same receipt, a rename through the session command route between prepare and apply exiting 4 with the digest unchanged, a dropped reply exiting 6 then operation get recorded and the rerun replaying with one version bump, and explicit adoption (boundIsCurrent false then true) before the next turn. Renewed CLI3 fixtures cover assignment creation between prepare and apply, identical UUIDs in distinct scopes and restoration. Bounded: adoption followed by a follow-up on a completed lead is covered by a deterministic test (#935), not the live journey, and routing, capacity and creation writes are fixture-only.

CLI04.basis: Stop, follow-up and Resume ran through the installed binary in the host live journey (issue-901-cli8-live-2026-10-12.json, Codex, 2 turns). Answers, approvals, recovery and staged comment review/confirm/send rely on the renewed CLI4-CLI6 fixtures (scripted GitHub dispatcher, seeded recovery facts, fixture runtime); they establish no real provider effect or independent recovery fact.

CLI05.basis: Renewed CLI7 deterministic suites cover redaction, instruction projection, historical and expired gaps, capture and storage failure, pruning and bounded read and follow; the host live journey (issue-901-cli8-live-2026-10-12.json, Codex, 2 turns) captured inputs, settings and events with no gaps. The diagnosticCapture CLI write is covered by deterministic fixtures only.

CLI06.basis: Host side real: the host live journey (issue-901-cli8-live-2026-10-12.json, Codex, 2 turns) identified the submitted inputs (digest match), commandExecution and dynamicToolCall items with the ensemble_report_result tool record, observed ENSEMBLE_MANAGED_ASSIGNMENT=1 in the Codex tool shell, and drove correction, adoption and one follow-up turn; deterministic boundary evidence is renewed. Missing: the private-remote half of the journey. Unproved: prerequisite unavailable (no second trusted machine was granted).

rows.revision: A stored result of another shape is 409 (exit 4); receipts for the seven configuration types, github.configure, github.preview and the five recovery types equal the POST receipt.
rows.retry: The same UUID in other scopes reads each scope's own receipt or not-recorded; a lost reply is reconciled by reading, or by a same-key rerun.
rows.gap: Real host journey in the CLI8 live record: installed from npm pack outside the checkout, loopback HTTP, live Codex (2 turns), scripted external client; other denial/revision/retry cases from the cited deterministic suites. Not run from a second machine over private HTTPS: prerequisite unavailable (no second trusted machine was granted).

rows.effect: project prepare --diagnostic-capture enhanced|baseline adds the mode to the one project.configure command, previewed as a field change; apply sets it and project get reads it back. Omitting the flag leaves the mode alone, and the current mode is refused as no change.
rows.denial: A read credential prepares (nothing is sent, the database digest is unchanged) and its apply exits 3 with the mode unchanged; a read-write credential applies.
rows.revision: A document prepared before another actor changed the project exits 4 on apply with the mode unchanged.
rows.retry: Applying the same document again returns the recorded receipt without another version change.
rows.gap: Deterministic fixture evidence only (CLI against a fixture service with real SQLite); the write is not part of the host live journey.

rows.effect: An authenticated session creates and lists named credentials with scope, creation, expiry and last-use metadata, reveals the token once, rotates by issuing a replacement before revoking the old credential and revokes with service readback.
rows.denial: A read credential cannot reach the credential routes (denied for both scopes); credentials cannot mint, extend or broaden authority; list responses never contain a token.
rows.revision: Rotation issues before it revokes; revocation is irreversible and read back from the service.
rows.retry: n/a: credential issuance is not a receipted command.
rows.gap: Qualified in Chromium against a loopback fixture service by the renewed suite only: no real-host or private-origin UI session, and the Settings credential section has no design frame (#904) while the legacy HTML UI has no credential controls. The journey harness issues credentials through the session endpoints but does not render the UI.

rows.revision: n/a: denial precedes any revision check.
rows.retry: n/a: a denied command leaves no receipt.

rows.denial: Session-only and legacy routes, credential routes and /runtime/control/* recovery, Stop and Resume posts are 403 for read and read-write bearer tokens; a session without CSRF is 403.
rows.revision: n/a: denial precedes any revision check.

rows.id: verified HTTPS transport and redirect rejection
rows.effect: Remote origins must be HTTPS and verified by system trust or NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS; a redirect is rejected (exit 5) and the credential is never forwarded to another origin; the CLI imports no service or SQLite code.
rows.denial: Rejected without NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS and accepted with it for a throwaway certificate; a redirect leaves no credential at the other origin; non-loopback http:// URLs are refused by the URL rules.
rows.revision: n/a: transport, not a versioned operation.
rows.retry: n/a: a transport refusal sent nothing.
rows.gap: The HTTPS proofs use a local TLS proxy with a throwaway certificate on the same host; no private route (Tailscale Serve), second machine or real certificate chain (prerequisite unavailable: no second trusted machine was granted).
